sentences.en: An office machine is cranking out a stream of documents.
sentences.zh: 这台办公机器正在源源不断地输出文件。

sentences.en: Hey! I don't want any crank calls - not at this hour.
sentences.zh: 喂！现在我不想接任何半夜来电。

sentences.en: This machine cranks out a thousand screws an hour.
sentences.zh: 这台机器每小时能生产一千个螺钉。
